market: Global Hot Melt Adhesive Dispensing Equipment Market
market_definition: Hot Melt Adhesive Dispensing Equipment comprises melters, hoses, guns, nozzles and application units designed to heat and dispense thermoplastic or reactive hot melt adhesives. The market covers equipment systems used in manufacturing and converting lines. By Equipment Type • Melters • Hoses and Applicators • Manual Guns • Automatic Guns • Nozzles and Modules By Heating System • Tank / Grid Melter • Drum / Pail Unloader • Hose-Heated Systems By Application Pattern • Bead • Spray • Slot / Curtain • Dot By Automation • Manual • Semi-Automatic • Automatic • Robotic By End Use • Packaging • Hygiene Products • Woodworking • Automotive • Textiles By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Hot melt adhesive materials, non-heated cold adhesive dispensers, general-purpose heating equipment and complete packaging or converting lines not sold as adhesive dispensing equipment. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - EQUIPMENT DISTRIBUTOR / DEALER: a distributor, authorised dealer, agent or system integrator that sells this equipment made by others to manufacturers. EXCLUDED companies: equipment makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR / CHANNEL PARTNER DEFINITION (hardware + software market): this market sells both hardware and software, so two shapes qualify - a stocking or authorized DISTRIBUTOR buying hardware in volume and reselling it, and a CHANNEL PARTNER, value-added reseller or SYSTEM INTEGRATOR that resells, bundles or implements another vendor's platform, software or modules. EXCLUDED: manufacturers, OEMs and their sales subsidiaries; vendors selling their own platform; consultancies with nothing to resell; and consumer-only retailers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
